questions.question: Directions: Select the option that is the passive form of the given sentence. This book explores the secret of leading a long and meaningful life.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the option that is the passive form of the given sentence.

This book explores the secret of leading a long and meaningful life.

options.text: The secret of leading a long and meaningful life was being explored by this book.

options.text: The secret of leading a long and meaningful life have been explored by this book.
options.html: The secret of leading a long and meaningful life have been explored by this book.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'The secret of leading a long and meaningful life is explored in this book.'

  • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
  • In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
  • The given sentence is in the active voice and 'This book' is the subject and 'the secret of leading a long and meaningful life' is the object.
  • When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject 'This book' of the active voice becomes the object, the object 'the secret of leading a long and meaningful life' becomes the subject.
  • The passive format "is + V3 (explored)" should be used.
  • This is the active and passive voice rule for the present simple tense.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:

questions.question: Select the option that correctly expresses the given sentence in passive voice. I will never overlook this creativity.

options.html: This creativity will not never be overlooked by me.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 1.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "I will never overlook this creativity."
  • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "this creativity" at the beginning.
  • Change the active verb form "will never overlook" to "will never be overlooked" (future simple passive).
  • Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "me."
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
Correct Sentence: "This creativity will never be overlooked by me."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 2: "This creativity will be overlooked by me." – Incorrect because it omits the word "never", changing the meaning.
  • Option 3: "This creativity will being overlooked by me." – Incorrect grammar (incorrect verb form).
  • Option 4: "This creativity will not never be overlooked by me." – Incorrect due to the double negative.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. The students must complete the assignment by Friday.

questions.solution:
Key Points

  • The original sentence is in the active voice, and to convert it to the passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
  • The modal verb 'must' remains unchanged when transforming the sentence from active to passive voice.
  • The phrase 'by the students' is added to indicate who is performing the action in the passive voice.
  • The verb 'complete' changes to 'be completed' to form the passive voice structure.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: The assignment must be completed by the students by Friday.

Additional Information

  • Option 2 ('The assignment will be completed by the students by Friday.') incorrectly changes the modal verb 'must' to 'will', altering the meaning and sense of obligation present in the original sentence.
  • Option 3 ('The students will have completed the assignment by Friday.') remains in active voice and changes the tense, making it an incorrect transformation.
  • Option 4 ('The assignment must be complete by Friday by the students.') is a less preferred construction due to awkward phrasing and redundancy in the placement of 'by the students'.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. The maid was dusting the hall when the door-bell rang.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'The door-bell rang when the hall was being dusted by the maid'.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is in the Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Passive Form. 
  • The structure of the given sentence as follows:
    • Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject(Objective Case)+ was/were + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
    • Example:
      • He was riding a bike.
      • A bike was being ridden by him.
    • The given sentence is an example of 'past continuous'. 
    • The given sentence has two clauses.
    • We have to change the voice of part one that is 'The maid was dusting the hall...'
    • 'was dusting' will be changed into 'was being dusted'.
    • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
    • The preposition 'by' will be added.
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.
    ​

Correct Sentence: The door-bell rang when the hall was being dusted by the maid. 

Hinglish

  • दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलना है।
  • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
    • Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject(Objective Case)+ was/were + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
    • Example:
      • He was riding a bike.
      • A bike was being ridden by him.
    • दिया गया वाक्य 'past continuous' का उदाहरण है।
    • दिए गए वाक्य में 'two clauses' हैं।
    • हमें पहले भाग की voice को बदलना होगा i.e. 'The maid was dusting the hall...'
    • 'was dusting' को 'was being dusted' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
    • Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखी जाएगी।
    • The preposition 'by' जोड़ा जाएगा।
  • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

Additional Information

  • Transformation of Infinitives:
  • Structure of it is as follows
    • Subject + is/am/are/was/were/has/have/had + to+ V1+ Object. 
    • Subject(Objective case) + is/am/are/was/were/has/have/had+to+be+ V3 + by+ object(subjective case). 
    • Example:
      • Your child is to learn chess. (Active Voice)
      • Chess is to be learnt by your child. (Passive Voice)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'A letter was written by Shiva to the head of the HR department in response to the advertisement.'

Key Points

  • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
  • In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
  • The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the past simple tense.
  • When we convert this sentence into a passive voice, the subject ''Shiva'' of the active voice becomes the object, the object ''a letter'' becomes the subject.
  • The active format "V2 (wrote)" should be converted into the passive format "was + V3 (written)".
  • This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Additional Information

Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:

TENSE ACTIVE PASSIVE PASSIVE CONVERSION
Present Simple He plays football am/is/are + V3 Football is played by him
Present Continuous He is playing football am/is/are + being +V3 Football is being played by him
Present Perfect He has played football Has/have + been+ V3 Football has been played by him
Present Perfect Continuous He has been playing football Not used and unusual. Not used and unusual
Past Simple He played football Was/were + V3 Football was played by him
Past Continuous He was playing football Was/were + being + V3 Football was being played by him
Past Perfect He had played football Had + been + V3 Football had been played by him
Past Perfect Continuous He had been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
Future Simple He will play football Will + be + V3 Football will be played by him
Future Continuous He will be playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
Future Perfect He will have played football Will have been + V3 Football will have been played by him
Future Perfect Continuous He will have been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
 

 

Hinglish

  • Active Voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
  • Passive Voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य active voice में है और यह past simple tense में है।
  • जब हम इस वाक्य को passive voice में बदलते हैं, तो active voice का subject 'Shiva', object बन जाता है और object 'a letter', subject बन जाता है।
  • Active format "V2 (wrote)" को passive format "was + V3 (written)" में परिवर्तित किया जाना चाहिए।
  • यह past simple tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।
     

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।
